name: Inami Mashiro
source:
She is a member of the Rhythmic Gymnastics Club, but is shy and extremely embarrassed. She is extremely timid and has a complex about her big breasts.

The main character helps her with hypnosis as a “spell to cure her shyness”. There, he discovers that she is a masochist who accepts any kind of eroticism as “normal” through hypnosis.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
